Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator made a critical factual error in its "EDUCATED GUESSES" section by incorrectly identifying "Metamorphosis" as a hallmark ability of Demon Hunters. In World of Warcraft, Metamorphosis is a signature ability of the **Druid** class (specifically the Feral specialization), not the Demon Hunter. This error led the Orchestrator to exclude the Druid from the initial class list and incorrectly assign the bear transformation role to the Demon Hunter (which is impossible, as Demon Hunters cannot transform into bears). This fundamental misunderstanding of class abilities caused the entire subsequent reasoning chain to be flawed, resulting in an invalid group composition that failed to satisfy the "bear" constraint properly.
